verdict.rationale: GlitchTip is open-source and self-hostable, which inherently lets an organization choose where its data lives by deploying the stack (backend, workers, Redis, Postgres) in any region or on-prem — evidenced by community reports of easy self-hosting. However, there is no explicit documentation of region/residency options for a hosted GlitchTip offering, no data-residency policy page, and no mention of multi-region storage controls. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region-selection documentation for hosted plans, formal compliance statements about storage location.
